titleStmt.title: Certified copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council, approved by his excellency the Governor-General in council, on the 19th November, 1892.

head.hi: Certified copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council, approved by his excellency the Governor-General in council, on the 19th November, 1892.

div.p: The committee of the privy council have had under consideration a dispatch hereto attached, dated 25th August, 1892, from Her Majesty’s chargé d’affaires at Washington, inclosing a copy of a note from the honorable the Secretary of State for the United States, setting forth the reasons which have compelled the President to issue the retaliatory proclamation in relation to the question of canal tolls.
The minister of railways and canals to whom the dispatch and inclosure were referred, reports under date 18th November, 1892 (report hereto attached), in which report the committee concur.

The committee, on the recommendation of the minister of railways and canals, advise that your excellency be moved to forward a copy hereof to the right honorable the Secretary of State for the colonies, and also to Her Majesty’s minister at Washington.
All which is respectfully submitted for your excellency’s approval.

closer.signed:
John J. McGee,
Clerk of the Privy Council.
